mapper.insert: INSERT INTO export_job (run_id, corporate_number) SELECT #{runId}, corporate_number FROM company_entry ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH claimed AS ( SELECT corporate_number FROM export_job WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status = 'pending' LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE export_job SET status = 'processing', claimed_by = #{instanceId}, claimed_at = now() FROM claimed WHERE export_job.corporate_number = claimed.corporate_number AND export_job.run_id = #{runId} RETURNING export_job.corporate_number
